apps.name: Sound2U
apps.description: Wereldwijde radio, podcasts, audiobulletins en lokale audio met Save2U, Stats2U en Wake2U.
apps.changelog:
Sound2U 0.3.69

Improved local radio popularity reliability. Temporary network/API errors no longer cause “Popular in [country]” to unexpectedly switch to worldwide results.
Added a silent persistent Wake2U status notification showing the next scheduled alarm.
Wake2U continues to use Android’s exact alarm system without background polling, timers or a persistent foreground service.
Country names now follow the selected Sound2U language. For example, US stations show “Verenigde Staten” in Dutch and “United States” in English.
Radio metadata is now displayed consistently as country · bitrate · codec, without stray separators when information is unavailable.
Made the Mood section more compact with smaller mood chips and reduced vertical space.
Refined bottom navigation so longer labels such as Settings/Instellingen remain fully visible.
Improved spacing, card radii, icon sizing and section-title consistency throughout the interface.
Reduced unnecessary Compose recompositions in radio lists and playback-related UI.
Added and improved stable keys in dynamic lists for smoother scrolling and more predictable UI updates.
Optimized artwork memory usage by downsampling large images before decoding for MediaSession/lock-screen artwork.
Reduced redundant artwork processing and temporary bitmap memory usage.
Various UI, performance, memory and stability refinements.

apps.name: VAT24
apps.description: Live VATSIM-radar met vluchten, ATC, vliegvelden, routes en vliegtuigfoto's.
apps.changelog:
VAT24 v1.0.15

- Fixed Android build errors introduced by the new region-aware radar startup.
- Replaced the unavailable ICU Region dependency with a local ISO country-to-continent mapping.
- Radar now opens at a useful continent-level view based on mobile network country, SIM country or Android region.
- No GPS permission, background location, worker or extra network request is used for startup positioning.
- Improved worldwide airport marker coverage, including airports that previously disappeared in wider regional views.
- Selected aircraft remain tracked and centered while moving, even after dismissing the compact detail card.
- Aircraft selection and route lines remain active until another aircraft is selected or the selection is cleared.
- Removed the redundant Search destination from the bottom navigation; search remains available directly on the radar.
- General stability, navigation and UI refinements.

apps.name: Esmarty
apps.description: Material You app voor het vinden en vergelijken van lokale prepaid-eSIMs.
apps.changelog: Esmarty changelog v0.5.4 - Provider links now open in Esmarty's own in-app browser by default instead of always handing the URL to Android's default browser. - Added automatic provider-page language detection and on-device translation with ML Kit. - Added website translation targets: System language, Dutch, English and Spanish. - Esmarty first prefers an official provider language variant when one is advertised by the site; otherwise it translates the visible page text. - Added Original / Translate switching plus an explicit Open in browser action. - Login, authentication, cart, checkout and payment flows are handed back to the user's normal browser. - Added an Esmarty settings dialog for in-app browser and translation preferences. - Fixed system theme handling: Esmarty now uses the dark palette when Android dark mode is enabled and the light palette otherwise. - The embedded browser follows system dark mode using WebView algorithmic darkening where supported. - Added explicit day/night system-bar styling. - Updated app version to 0.5.4 (versionCode 10).

apps.name: WeatherMe
apps.description: Material You weer-app met verwachtingen, waarschuwingen, radar en weerdetails.
apps.changelog:
WeatherMe 2.4.4

Country names now follow the selected WeatherMe language instead of displaying raw provider/API country names.
For example, the United States is shown as “Verenigde Staten” in Dutch and “United States” in English.
Improved bottom navigation so longer labels such as Warnings and Settings remain fully visible.
Added stable keys to dynamic forecast, warning, favorite and context-card lists for smoother and more predictable Compose updates.
Removed unused map bitmap state and obsolete animation code.
MapLibre remains lazily initialized only when the map is actually opened.
Existing background weather, warning and rain scheduling remains unchanged.
No additional polling, workers, services or location requests were added.
Various UI, localization, memory and performance refinements.

apps.name: SkyRadar
apps.description: Live aircraft spotting met vliegtuigfoto's, kaart, slimme meldingen en uitgebreide spotterfuncties.
apps.changelog:
SkyRadar 1.0.0-alpha13.0

- Completely redesigned Material 3 interface.
- Nearby aircraft is now the default home screen.
- Aircraft cards show photos, distance, altitude, speed, registration and aircraft type.
- Tap an aircraft to open and select it directly on the live map.
- Added smart proximity notifications.
- Filter notifications by radius, airline and aircraft type.
- Added maximum altitude filters.
- Added favorite aircraft registrations and alerts.
- Added special aircraft filtering for aircraft such as the A380, Boeing 747, Antonov and military traffic.
- Added likely-overflight detection using distance, altitude, speed and heading.
- Added Spotter section with Favorites and Today.
- Today records nearby aircraft including minimum distance and time of passage.
- Improved aircraft photo matching and caching.
- Improved location updates, navigation and overall stability.

apps.name: Customer Nearby
apps.description: Wereldwijde klantenservicezoeker met telefoon, WhatsApp, e-mail, websites en storingsinformatie.
apps.changelog: Customer Nearby 0.2.13 - Added direct curated Netherlands customer-service call actions for DELTA (0118 22 55 75), Ziggo (0900 1884) and Odido (0800 0092), while retaining existing KPN/Vodafone/Guidion profiles. - Added Odido's international service number and normalized current first-party support routes for Ziggo and Odido. - Booking.com NL now shows a descriptive Bericht of bel 24/7 action that opens Booking.com's official localized support flow instead of inventing a fixed phone number. - Contact-cache schema bumped to 7 so older sparse cached profiles cannot hide new curated contact actions. - Split outage routing into a user-facing preferred status URL and a separate regional automatic-detection URL. - KPN, Ziggo, Odido and DELTA now open verified first-party status/service checkers from the outage UI where available. - Added DELTA to the Netherlands outage catalogue. - Added a 30-minute per-country automatic backoff after regional outage-source 403/429 responses, preventing repeated Home/company-open retries against a temporarily blocked source. - Manual outage refresh may still explicitly retry; failed/unparseable checks remain UNKNOWN and never become false outage cards. - Added Dutch/English/Spanish strings for the new official-status and Booking.com contact UI. - Version bumped to 0.2.13 / versionCode 17.

apps.name: DataMaat
apps.description: Slim inzicht in je mobiele databundel, appverbruik, SIM/eSIM-wissels, roaming en dataverbruik.
apps.changelog:
DataMaat 0.2.4

Added manual carrier usage correction for situations where Android's measured total differs from your provider's reported usage.
Enter the current carrier value in MB or GB; DataMaat then continues counting new Android-measured usage from that point.
Manual corrections are automatically tied to the active billing cycle and SIM/eSIM session, preventing old corrections from carrying over into a new period.
Remaining data, forecast, pacing, widgets and usage warnings now use the corrected total when a carrier baseline is active.
Per-app usage and “Used today” remain direct Android measurements and are never artificially adjusted.
Improved bottom navigation with compact single-line labels.
Improved localization of unknown carrier, unknown app and country labels across the app and widgets.
Widget country names now follow the selected DataMaat language.
App icons are now loaded asynchronously instead of being decoded on the Compose main thread.
App icons are resized to 96×96 and stored in a bounded cache for smoother scrolling and lower memory usage.
Existing SIM/eSIM detection, roaming logic and NetworkStats calculations remain unchanged.
No new timers, services, polling or background workers were added.
Various UI, performance and stability refinements.

apps.name: GetMe
apps.description: Eigen Material You appcatalogus en veilige updater voor directe APK-releases.
apps.changelog:
GetMe 1.4.0

- Added a new Update Center with update count and Update all.
- Added app details, categories, favorites and My apps.
- Added installed, update available, new and updated status indicators.
- Added resumable APK downloads with progress, pause, cancel and retry.
- Added optional Wi-Fi-only downloads.
- Added APK package, version, signature and SHA-256 verification.
- Added previous-version history with guarded rollback support.
- Added battery-friendly automatic update checks.
- Added catalog validation and safer cache handling.
- GetMe can now update itself through GetMe.
